📘New words — كل كلمات الوحدةالكلمات الجديدة

اضغط 🔊 لتسمع نطق الكلمة بصوت بشرى طبيعى.
schoolمدرسة
the place where children learn
classroomفصل / حجرة الدراسة
the room where you have your lessons
boardسبورة
the teacher writes on it in front of the class
chairكرسى
you sit on it
bagحقيبة
you put your books in it
bookكتاب
you read it and learn from it
pencil caseمقلمة
a small bag for your pencils and pens
teacherمعلّم / معلّمة
the person who teaches you at school
friendصديق
a person you like and play with
studentتلميذ / طالب
a child who goes to school to learn

صفحة 5Reading Comprehensionتكملة القطعة

الجزء الثانى

00:00 / 00:00 اسحب على الشريط للتنقّل · اضغط أى كلمة فى النص للانتقال إليها

Peter is my best friend. This is my new classroom in grade one. The class is big. The board is green. I sit on a brown chair. I put my books in a blue bag. I put my pencils in my pencil case. Miss Jenny is my teacher. I like my class, my friends and my teacher.

🎧 اضغط «استمع» لتسمع القطعة بصوت بشرى — وستُظلَّل كل كلمة أثناء قراءتها.

صفحة 61 — Write (True) or (False)صح أم خطأ

1 John is a student.
True ✔ — John goes to Smart School — he is a student.
2 The class is big.
True ✔ — “The class is big.”
3 The chair is blue.
False ✘ — It is a brown chair, not blue.
4 Peter is John’s friend.
True ✔ — “Peter is my best friend.”

1 — Punctuate the following sentences.

5 i am a boy
I am a boy.

She is my sister.
7 they live in a big house

Mary is my best friend.
